comment: Invoice Submission Payload without PDF (SAISIE_API mode)
description: Example of an invoice submitted to Chorus Pro without PDF attachment - useful for testing business logic in isolation

fieldDescriptions.modeDepot: Set to 'SAISIE_API' when NO PDF is attached
fieldDescriptions.pieceJointePrincipale: MUST be an empty array [] for SAISIE_API mode
fieldDescriptions.pieceJointeComplementaire: Additional attachments (also empty for pure data entry)
fieldDescriptions.lignePoste: Multiple line items are encouraged to test line-level calculations
fieldDescriptions.ligneTva: Can have multiple VAT rates if needed

keyDifferencesFromPdfMode: All invoice details must be provided as structured data
Useful for testing invoice metadata, calculations, and business rules without PDF dependencies
Ideal for isolated testing of Chorus business logic
useCase: Testing business rule validation (amount matching, dates, IDs)
Isolating PDF upload issues from invoice submission issues
Quick testing of invoice metadata without file I/O overhead
howToUse: 1. No need to upload a PDF first
2. Fill in all fournisseur/supplier details from Chorus context
3. Fill in destinataire details from the target customer
4. Populate lignePoste and ligneTva with real invoice data
6. POST this payload directly to /cpro/factures/v1/soumettre with Bearer token
7. If errors occur, they will be purely business logic errors, not file-related
